title: Calculation and rejection diverge in language models tested at known mechanical limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.38096v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a language model returns engineering quantities with the status "solved", software that trusts it passes them on, even when the requested design is physically impossible. Such failures could reflect poor calculation, how the answer is requested, or a failure to judge feasibility. We set beam loads and disk speeds at known percentages above or below plastic collapse or burst, measured each model's limit calculation separately and tested 12 models in 4,860 calls, including follow-up experiments on new designs. We find that a model can recognize an impossible design when asked only whether it is feasible, yet accept the same design, reporting "solved", when asked for a full answer. Three models accepted beams 10 to 30% beyond collapse despite precise limit calculations in separate questions, and many accepted replies stated the violation. translated_title: 在已知力学极限下测试的语言模型中，计算能力与拒绝能力出现分化
translated_abstract: 当语言模型返回带有“已解决”状态的工程量时，信任它的软件会将这些数值继续传递下去，即使所请求的设计在物理上是不可能实现的。这类失败可能反映出计算能力不足、提问方式的问题，或无法判断可行性。我们将梁载荷和圆盘转速设定在塑性屈曲或爆裂极限之上或之下的已知百分比，分别测量每个模型的极限计算能力，并在4,860次调用中测试了12个模型，包括针对新设计的后续实验。我们发现，当只被问及设计是否可行时，模型能够识别出不可能的设计；但当被要求给出完整答案时，模型却会接受同样的设计并报告“已解决”。三个模型在单独的问题中能够精确计算极限，却接受了超出屈曲极限10%到30%的梁设计，而且许多被接受的回复中明确指出了这一超限。当只询问可行性时，Opus 5和Gemini 3.8 Flash拒绝了每一个不可能的新设计。
tldr: 语言模型即使能精确计算力学极限、并在被单独询问时识别出物理上不可能的设计，在被要求给出完整答案时仍会接受这些不可能的设计并报告“已解决”，表明其计算能力与可行性拒绝能力之间存在明显分化。
en_tdlr: Language models can precisely calculate mechanical limits and recognize physically impossible designs when asked about feasibility, yet still accept the same impossible designs and report "solved" when asked for a full answer, revealing a divergence between their calculation and rejection capabilities.
